name: Desidentity 1.2
source:
Desidentity tells the story of a universe inhabited by creatures of all kinds, with a theme based on one of the most well-known aesthetics on the internet. Sometimes, unfortunately, human beings (referred to as "gizakias" by the creatures that inhabit it) arrive in this world. These humans have no memories of their lives before entering the new dimension. If a being encounters a gizakia wandering in the rear quarters, for moral reasons, they must guide them to the exit, as from the moment of their encounter, the original being becomes their Guardian. 

Only a small percentage of the population is the "privileged" ones who achieve this designation. When seeing a being accompanied by a gizakia, it is highly frowned upon to react differently or excessively. 

All of this serves to help the Gizakia and the being to adjust more easily to their new life.

[from [url=https://weirdcoresome.itch.io/desidentity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《身份认同》讲述了一个居住着各种生物的宇宙的故事，其主题基于互联网上最著名的美学之一。有时，不幸的是，人类（被居住在其中的生物称为“gizakias”）来到了这个世界。这些人类对于进入新维度之前的生活没有任何记忆。如果一个生命体遇到了在后院徘徊的吉扎奇亚人，出于道德原因，他们必须将其引导到出口，因为从遇到的那一刻起，原来的生物体就成为了他们的守护者。

只有一小部分人口是获得这一称号的“特权”人群。当看到有吉扎吉亚陪伴的生物时，做出不同或过度的反应是非常不受欢迎的。

所有这一切都有助于帮助Gizakia和众生更容易地适应他们的新生活。

[来自[url=https://weirdcoresome.itch.io/desidentity]Itch.io[/url]]
